:::{#def-set-predicate-notation}
#### Set notation for indicators

An indicator (@def-indicator-function) is written in **set notation**
when the set $A$ appears as a subscript,
as in $\indic{A}(x)$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-predicate-notation}
#### Predicate notation for indicators

An indicator (@def-indicator-function) is written in **predicate notation**
when a proposition or predicate $P$ ([definition](proof-writing.qmd#def-predicate)) appears as its argument,
as in $\indicp{P}$ or $\indicp{x \in A}$.

:::
